home_title: Microsoft's Fluent UI components for Svelte 5
home_description: FluentUI Svelte is a collection of accessible Svelte components that make it easy to create beautiful web applications with the premium look and feel of Microsoft's Fluent UI.
docs_overview_description: Welcome to the FluentUI Svelte documentation! This page will explain the basic concepts of the library.
docs_overview_attention_description: This package isn't a exact re-implementation of Fluent UI, many features are not exactly as described in the FluentUI Documentation.
docs_overview_what_is_description: FluentUI Svelte is a collection of accessible Svelte components that make it easy to create beautiful web applications with the premium look and feel of Microsoft's Fluent UI.
docs_overview_undocumented_description_b: This documentation is a work in progress. A lot of components are not documented yet. If you want to contribute to the documentation, please check the

gs_installation_description: To install FluentUI Svelte, run one of the following commands:

gs_required_css_bullet2_before_code: Or, you can also copy the CSS file from the

about_intro_bold: Firstly, thank you for checking out this project!
about_intro_after_bold: FluentUI Svelte was created to provide a set of Svelte components that follow the Fluent UI design system for another personal project.
about_paragraph2_before_wip: After a lot of work, I decided to open source it so that others can use it as well. This UI is extremely useful for building business style applications that need to have a consistent look and feel. In other hand, its accessibility features
about_paragraph2_after_wip: are top notch, which is a must for any business application.
about_paragraph3: Although I'm trying to update this package as much as possible, I'm really short on time due to my current work. I'd like to ask you to support both this project and the FluentUI project directly with a star or donation. Believe me, it will be greatly appreciated!
asb_description: The AutoSuggestBox component provides an input field with dynamic suggestions as users type. It enhances user experience by offering relevant suggestions, improving efficiency in form inputs and searches.
asb_component_api_description_before_lin: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
asb_suggestions_description: Suggestions are provided as {#code}AutoSuggestBoxOption{/code} a children of the {#code}AutoSuggestBox{/code}. As the user types, matching options will be shown.
asb_keyboard_navigation_description: Users can navigate through suggestions using the Up and Down arrow keys. Pressing Enter selects the highlighted suggestion.
asb_max_items_description: The `maxItemsInView` prop sets how many suggestions are visible before the flyout scrolls. If the number of options exceeds this value, a scrollbar will appear.
asb_suggestion_chosen_description: The `suggestionChosen` event is triggered when a user selects a suggestion from the list. The chosen suggestion value is passed as the second argument.
asb_query_submitted_description: The `querySubmitted` event is triggered when the user submits a query through the Search Button or typically by pressing Enter. This event can be used to handle the submission of the current input value.
asb_props_placeholder_description: Placeholder text shown in the input.
asb_props_value_description: The current value of the input field.
asb_props_open_description: Whether the suggestion flyout is open. Default: `false`.
asb_props_selectonfocus_description: Select a suggestion as it is focused during keyboard navigation.
asb_props_notfoundtext_description: Text shown when no suggestions match. Default: `No results found`.
asb_props_maxitemsinview_description: Number of suggestions visible before the flyout scrolls. Default: `6`.
asb_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the auto-suggest box element.
asb_props_suggestionchosen_description: Event triggered when a suggestion is chosen.
asb_props_querysubmitted_description: Event triggered when a query is submitted.
cdp_description: Documentation for Calendar Date Picker coming soon.
btn_description: A button triggers an action or event when activated and supports three visual appearances: accent, standard, and subtle.
btn_component_api_description_before_lin: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
btn_as_description: You can control which tag the button component should use: button, a, or div.
btn_shape_description: A button can be rounded, circular, or square. Default: rounded.
btn_appearance_description: A button can have its content and borders styled for greater emphasis or to be subtle.
btn_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the button element.
btn_props_as_description: The DOM element to render. Possible values: 'button', 'a', 'div'.
btn_props_shape_description: The shape of the button or buttons. Possible values: 'circular', 'rounded', 'square'.
btn_props_appearance_description: The appearance of the button or buttons. Possible values: 'accent', 'standard', 'subtle'.
btn_props_disabledfocusable_description: Allows the button to be focusable even when disabled.
btn_props_ismenubutton_description: Adds an icon that indicates the button triggers a menu.
btn_props_indicatorposition_description: The position of the icon. Possible values: 'before', 'after'.
btn_props_indicatoricon_description: The icon used as the menu indicator. Defaults to a chevron-down icon.
btn_props_elementattributes_description: Based on the chosen component tag, you will get autocomplete for all HTML attributes of that tag.
btn_split_button_description: A split button is a special type of button that combines a standard button with a menu button to provide users with a primary action and additional options.
btn_adding_a_menu_description_before_lin: To add a menu to the split button, please refer to the
btn_adding_a_menu_description_after_link: for details on how to create menus and pass them as a prop to the SplitButton component.
btn_props_wrapperref_description: The DOM reference of the split button wrapper element.
btn_props_primarybuttonref_description: The DOM reference of the primary button element.
btn_props_primarybuttonprops_description: Additional props to pass to the primary button.
btn_props_menutriggerref_description: The DOM reference of the menu trigger button element.
btn_props_menutriggerprops_description: Additional props to pass to the menu trigger button.
btn_props_class_description: Additional classes to add to the split button wrapper element.
btn_props_wrapperelementattributes_descr: All other attributes can be applied to the split button wrapper element.
bc_description: The Breadcrumb component provides a navigational aid to indicate the user's location within an application or website. It enhances usability by allowing quick navigation back to previous sections.
bc_early_access_title: This component is available in early access.
bc_early_access_description_before_link: The API, features, and behavior of the component are subject to significant changes. This component will be rebuilt using the
bc_early_access_description_after_link: package, which is still under active development. We strongly advise against using this component in production environments at this time.
bc_props_items_description: An array of breadcrumb items, each with a name and path. The disabled property can be used to disable specific items.
bc_props_maxvisible_description: The maximum number of breadcrumb items to display. If the number of items exceeds this value, an ellipsis will be shown. Default: 5.
bc_props_appearance_description: The appearance of the breadcrumb. Possible values: 'default', 'minimal'. Default: 'default'.
bc_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the breadcrumb element.
bc_props_hidefrom_description: The number to start hiding items from.
bc_props_size_description: The size of the breadcrumb items in pixels.
badge_description: A badge is a visual decoration for UI elements used to display notifications, status indicators, or counts. It supports different colors and styles to match various UI needs.
badge_api_description_before_link: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
badge_appearance_description: Use the appearance prop to switch between filled, outline, tint, and ghost styles.
badge_sizes_description: Use the size prop to control the badge dimensions.
badge_shapes_description: Use the shape prop to render circular, rounded, or square badges.
badge_color_description: Use the color prop to communicate different statuses and priorities.
badge_icon_description: Use the icon prop to render an icon inside the badge. You can pass the icon as a snippet or as a component.
badge_only_icon_description: If you use this component and notice padding between the wrapper and the icon, use the BadgeIcon component instead to avoid it.
badge_props_size_description: The size of the badge in pixels.
badge_props_shape_description: The shape of the badge. Possible values: 'circular', 'rounded', 'square'.
badge_props_appearance_description: The appearance of the badge. Possible values: 'filled', 'outline', 'ghost', 'tint'.
badge_props_iconposition_description: The position of the icon inside the badge. Possible values: 'before', 'after'.
badge_props_color_description: The color of the badge. Possible values: 'information', 'attention', 'warning', 'success', 'critical'.
badge_props_icon_description: The icon to display inside the badge.
badge_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the badge element.
badge_props_children_description: The children elements to render inside the badge.
badge_badgeicon_api_description: This component is useful when you want to show an icon in the form of a Badge somewhere in your app.
badge_badgeicon_avatar_example_descripti: One example is using this component inside Avatar:
badge_badgeicon_avatar_details_descripti: By default, Avatar uses an instance of BadgeIcon. As you can see, the first example on the left uses the Badge component, which adds unwanted padding inside it. In Avatar, you can use one of the predefined BadgeIcon options, or set a custom icon by passing it as a property. avatar_description: An Avatar is a graphical representation of a user, team, or entity.
avatar_overview_description: Avatar can display an image, icon, or initials, and supports different sizes, shapes, and status indicators.
avatar_component_api_description_before_: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
avatar_image_description: An avatar can display an image. It is recommended to also include a name in addition to the image: the initials from the name are displayed while the image is loading, and the name makes the Avatar accessible to screen readers.
avatar_icon_description: An avatar can display an icon. The icon will only be shown when there is no image or initials available.
avatar_badge_description: An avatar can have a badge to indicate presence status. See the PresenceBadge component for more info.
avatar_shape_description: An avatar can have a square, circular, or rounded shape.
avatar_colorful_description: An avatar can have its color automatically picked based on the name prop, or idForColor can be used if a name is not available.
avatar_props_name_description: The name of the person or entity represented by this Avatar. Used to determine initials and for accessibility tools.
avatar_props_image_description: The Avatar image. It can only be a single image URL.
avatar_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the avatar element.
avatar_props_size_description: Size of the avatar in pixels.
avatar_props_shape_description: The shape of the avatar. Possible values: 'circular', 'rounded', 'square'.
avatar_props_color_description: The color used when displaying either an icon or initials. Supports system colors. Possible values: 'information', 'attention', 'warning', 'success', 'critical', 'colorful'.
avatar_props_active_description: Optional activity indicator. Possible values: 'active', 'inactive'. Active decorates the avatar according to activeAppearance. Inactive reduces size and makes it partially transparent.
avatar_props_activeappearance_descriptio: The appearance used when active is set to active. Possible values: 'ring', 'shadow', 'ring-shadow'.
avatar_props_initials_description: Custom initials. By default, initials are derived from the name prop using the getInitials function. They are displayed when there is no image.
avatar_props_idforcolor_description: A string used instead of the name to determine the color when color is set to colorful. Useful when a name is unavailable but another unique identifier exists.
avatar_props_icon_description: The icon to display when the avatar does not have an image or initials.
avatar_props_badge_description: The badge to display as a status indicator. It can include a custom icon.
cm_description: The Context Menu component provides a customizable right-click menu for contextual actions. It enhances user interaction by offering relevant options based on the context.
cm_early_access_title: This component is available in early access.
cm_early_access_description_before_link: The API, features, and behavior of the component are subject to significant changes. This component will be rebuilt using the
cm_early_access_description_after_link: package, which is still under active development. We strongly advise against using this component in production environments at this time.
cm_props_hasicons_description: Whether the context menu has icons. Default: false.
cm_props_defaultopen_description: Whether the context menu is open by default. Default: false.
cm_props_opendelay_description: Delay in milliseconds before the context menu opens. Default: 100.
cm_props_closedelay_description: Delay in milliseconds before the context menu closes. Default: 100.
cm_props_ref_description: A reference to the context menu element. Used for positioning and interaction.
cm_props_positioning_description: The positioning strategy for the context menu. Possible values: 'top-start', 'top-end', 'right-start', 'right-end', 'bottom-start', 'bottom-end', 'left-start', 'left-end'.
cm_props_margin_description: The margin around the context menu. Default: 8.
cm_props_positionconfig_description: Configuration object for positioning the context menu.
cm_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the context menu element.
cm_props_children_description: The children elements to render inside the context menu.
cb_description: Represents a control that a user can select (check) or clear (uncheck). A CheckBox can also report its value as indeterminate.
cb_component_api_description_before_link: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
cb_label_description: To display a visible label, set `wrapperAs="label"` and pass the label text as children. The wrapper then renders as a `<label>` element that wraps the input.
cb_checked_description: The `checked` prop determines whether the checkbox is checked or not. It accepts a boolean value.
cb_indeterminate_description: The `indeterminate` prop sets the checkbox to an indeterminate state, which is useful for representing a mixed selection.
cb_disabled_description: The `disabled` prop disables the checkbox, preventing user interaction. It accepts a boolean value.
cb_value_description: The `value` prop sets the value of the checkbox input. It is useful when the checkbox is part of a form submission.
cb_props_wrapperas_description: The element the wrapper renders as. Set to `label` to show a visible label. Defaults to `div`.
cb_props_children_description: Label content rendered next to the input. Only allowed when `wrapperAs="label"`.
cb_props_checked_description: Determines if the checkbox is checked.
cb_props_indeterminate_description: Sets the checkbox to an indeterminate state.
cb_props_disabled_description: Disables the checkbox, preventing user interaction.
cb_props_value_description: The value of the checkbox input, useful for form submissions.
cb_props_wrapperattributes_description: Additional attributes for the wrapper element.
cb_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the checkbox input element.
cb_props_wrapperref_description: The DOM reference of the checkbox wrapper element.
cb_props_inputattributes_description: Additional attributes for the checkbox input element.
dialog_description: Is a window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window. Windows under a modal dialog are inert. That is, users cannot interact with content outside an active dialog window. Inert content outside an active dialog is typically visually obscured or dimmed so it is difficult to discern, and in some implementations, attempts to interact with the inert content cause the dialog to close.
dialog_early_access_title: This component is available in early access.
dialog_early_access_description: The API, features, and behavior of the component are subject to significant changes. We strongly advise against using this component in production environments at this time.
dialog_composition_description: The Dialog is composed of several components that work together through a shared context:
dialog_composition_dialog_description: The root component that creates the state and provides context to its children.
dialog_composition_dialogtrigger_descrip: A button that opens the dialog when clicked.
dialog_composition_dialogsurface_descrip: The `<dialog>` element that hosts the dialog content.
dialog_composition_dialogtitle_descripti: The heading of the dialog. Renders as an `h3` by default.
dialog_composition_dialogcontent_descrip: The scrollable body of the dialog.
dialog_composition_dialogactions_descrip: The footer that holds action buttons.
dialog_props_type_description: The behavior type of the dialog. Default: `modal`.
dialog_props_onopenchange_description: Callback fired when the dialog opens or closes.
dialog_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the trigger button.
dialog_props_trigger_children_descriptio: The content of the trigger button.
dialog_props_surface_ref_description: The DOM reference of the dialog element.
dialog_props_surface_children_descriptio: The content to render inside the dialog surface.
dialog_props_as_description: The element to render the title as. Default: `h3`.
dialog_props_title_ref_description: The DOM reference of the title element.
dialog_props_title_attributes_descriptio: All HTML attributes of the chosen `as` element are forwarded.
dialog_props_content_ref_description: The DOM reference of the content element.
dialog_props_content_children_descriptio: The content to render inside the dialog body.
dialog_props_actions_ref_description: The DOM reference of the actions element.
dialog_props_position_description: Horizontal alignment of the actions. Default: `end`.
dialog_props_fluid_description: Whether the actions container uses a full-width layout.
dialog_props_actions_children_descriptio: The action elements to render, typically buttons.
divider_description: The Divider component is used to visually separate content within a layout. It can be oriented horizontally or vertically.
divider_divider_api_description_before_l: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
divider_appearance_description: Controls the color of the divider. Possible values: `'standard'`, `'accent'`, `'subtle'`.
divider_vertical_description: When `vertical` is set, the divider renders on the vertical axis instead of the horizontal one. Make sure the parent container has a defined height so the divider is visible.
divider_align_content_description: The `alignContent` prop controls where the label content (children) is positioned along the divider. Possible values: `'start'`, `'center'`, `'end'`.
divider_align_content_vertical_descripti: It also works combined with the `vertical` prop:
divider_inset_description: When `inset` is set, the divider gets some inline padding applied, useful when it's placed inside a container that has content touching its edges.
divider_custom_element_description: The `as` prop lets you change the underlying HTML element rendered by the divider. Possible values: `'div'`, `'hr'`, `'span'`.
divider_props_as_description: The HTML element to render the divider as. Possible values: `'div'`, `'hr'`, `'span'`.
divider_props_vertical_description: Whether the divider is rendered vertically instead of horizontally.
divider_props_aligncontent_description: The alignment of the content within the divider. Possible values: `'start'`, `'center'`, `'end'`.
divider_props_appearance_description: The appearance of the divider. Possible values: `'default'`, `'accent'`, `'standard'`, `'subtle'`.
divider_props_inset_description: Whether the divider has inline padding applied.
divider_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the divider element, its type depends on the `as` prop.
divider_props_children_description: The content to render as a label within the divider.
expander_description: Control that displays a header and a collapsible content area.
expander_usage_description: A basic expander expects a header and its content. You can configure the header by passing the `header` property. Content can be provided as child elements of the component. By default, the content container has no padding, this allows you to use 100% of the content width if needed.
expander_component_api_description_befor: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
expander_controlling_expansion_descripti: Expanders can be either expanded or collapsed. This can be controlled by setting the `expanded` property.
expander_opening_direction_description: An expander doesn’t have to expand downwards. You can control an expander’s expansion direction using the `direction` property. To create an upwards-expanding expander, set `direction` to `up`.
expander_adding_an_icon_description: You can easily add an icon to an expander’s header using the `Icon` prop. You can pass either a Snippet or a Component.
expander_adding_an_icon_snippet_intro_de: When using Snippet, you have two options:
expander_adding_an_icon_option_apply_sty: Apply the styles to the icon yourself
expander_adding_an_icon_option_spread_pr: Spread the Snippet props into the SVG element
expander_props_description_description: Description to render below the header.
expander_props_direction_description: The opening direction of the expander. Possible values: `'down'`, `'up'`.
expander_props_justify_description: Whether the expander is justified to the full width of the container.
expander_props_expanded_description: Controls the opening state of the expander.
expander_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the expander element.
expander_props_icon_description: The icon to display before the label.
expander_props_children_description: The children elements to render inside the expander.
dd_description: The Dropdown component allows users to select an option from a list. It supports various sizes, disabled states, and customizable options for better user interaction.
dd_early_access_title: This component is available in early access.
dd_early_access_description_prefix: The API, features, and behavior of the component are subject to significant changes. This component will be rebuilt using the
dd_early_access_description_suffix: package, which is still under active development. We strongly advise against using this component in production environments at this time.
ds_description: The Dropdown Select component allows users to select an option from a list. It supports various sizes, disabled states, and customizable options for better user interaction.
ds_early_access_title: This component is available in early access.
ds_early_access_description_prefix: The API, features, and behavior of the component are subject to significant changes. This component will be rebuilt using the
ds_early_access_description_suffix: package, which is still under active development. We strongly advise against using this component in production environments at this time.
hl_description: The Hyperlink component is used to create clickable links that navigate to a specified URL. It follows Fluent UI design principles and ensures accessibility and smooth user interactions.
hl_props_href_description: The URL to navigate to when the link is clicked.
hl_props_disabled_description: Disables the hyperlink and prevents navigation.
hl_props_ref_description: A bindable reference to the underlying anchor element.
hl_props_elementattributes_description: You can use any valid HTML anchor attributes (e.g., target, rel, etc.).
flyout_description: The Flyout component is a floating panel that can be used to display additional information or options in a non-intrusive way. It is fully accessible and follows Fluent UI design principles for a seamless user experience.
flyout_props_ref_description: The DOM reference to the flyout element.
flyout_props_children_description: The content to be displayed inside the flyout.
flyout_props_floating_description: Whether to use Floating UI for positioning. Default: false.
flyout_props_reference_description: The reference element for Floating UI.
flyout_props_placement_description: The placement for Floating UI positioning. Default: 'bottom'.
flyout_props_onplacementchange_descripti: A callback that is called when the placement changes.
flyout_props_offset_description: The offset for Floating UI positioning. Default: 8.
flyout_props_elementattributes_descripti: All other attributes that can be applied to the flyout element.
lv_description: The ListView is a component for rendering a set of vertically stacked items. These items can be focusable, selectable, have one primary action and one or more secondary actions, and support keyboard navigation and accessibility features.
lv_listview_as_description: You can control which tag the ListView component should use: ul, ol, or div. Default: ul.
lv_listview_shape_description: Instead of setting this on every ListViewItem, you can set it here and every item will inherit it. Possible values are rounded, circular, or square. Default: rounded.
lv_navigation_mode_description: This option allows you to set keyboard navigation based on your needs. For view-only data, you do not need to set this unless the items perform some action. If your items have multiple actionable elements within the ListViewItem, like buttons or menus, you can set this to composite.
lv_listview_props_as_description: The HTML tag to use for the list container. Possible values: ul, ol, div.
lv_listview_props_selectionmode_descript: Selection mode for the list. Possible values: single, multiselect, extended.
lv_listview_props_navigationmode_descrip: Navigation mode for keyboard navigation. Possible values: items, composite.
lv_listview_props_shape_description: The shape of the list items. Possible values: rounded, circular, square.
lv_listview_props_onselectionchange_desc: Callback fired when the selection changes.
lv_listview_props_element_description: Reference to the list DOM element. Depends on the selected as value.
lv_listview_props_elementattributes_desc: Based on the chosen as value, you will have autocomplete for all HTML attributes of that tag.
lv_listviewitem_as_description: You can control which tag the ListViewItem component should use: li, a, or div. Default: li.
lv_listviewitem_shape_description: Use this to set the corner radius. Possible values are rounded, circular, or square. Default: rounded.
lv_listviewitem_value_description: Sets the value of the current item. You must set this when using the ListView selection system or if items change dynamically.
lv_listviewitem_on_action_description: This event is triggered when clicking or tapping the element. It executes the primary action and, if the role is not row, it also executes the selection itself.
lv_listviewitem_checkmark_description_pr: Add and configure a checkbox for the element. You can use the same props for the
lv_checkmark_example_note_description: Note: every actionable element inside this ListViewItem must call e.stopPropagation().
lv_listviewitem_props_as_description: The HTML tag to use for the item container. Possible values: li, a, div.
lv_listviewitem_props_active_description: Whether the item is currently active or selected.
lv_listviewitem_props_shape_description: The shape of the item. Possible values: rounded, circular, square.
lv_listviewitem_props_value_description: The value of the item used for selection.
lv_listviewitem_props_onaction_descripti: Callback fired when the item is activated.
lv_listviewitem_props_onfocus_descriptio: Callback fired when the item receives focus.
lv_listviewitem_props_role_description: ARIA role for the item. Possible values: treeitem, menuitem, option, row.
lv_listviewitem_props_checkmark_descript: Props for the checkmark or checkbox.
lv_listviewitem_props_elementattributes_: Based on the chosen as value, you will have autocomplete for all HTML attributes of that tag.
ib_description: The InfoBar control is for displaying app-wide status messages to users that are highly visible yet non-intrusive. There are built-in severity levels to easily indicate the type of message shown, as well as the option to include your own call to action or hyperlink button. Since the InfoBar is inline with other UI content, it can remain visible or be dismissed by the user.
ib_component_api_description_prefix: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
ib_status_description: The status prop determines the visual style and meaning of the InfoBar.
ib_style_description: The style prop determines the layout of the InfoBar.
ib_hide_close_button_description: The hideCloseButton prop allows you to hide the close button in the InfoBar.
ib_props_status_description: The status of the InfoBar. Possible values: 'information', 'attention', 'warning', 'critical', 'success'.
ib_props_style_description: The style of the InfoBar. Possible values: 'inline', 'multiline'.
ib_props_icon_description: The icon to display in the InfoBar.
ib_props_iconsize_description: The size of the icon in pixels. Default: 20.
ib_props_hideclosebutton_description: Whether to hide the close button. Default: false.
ib_props_children_description: The child elements to render inside the InfoBar.
menu_description: Menu is a component for displaying a list of actions or options in a dropdown format. It can be used in various contexts, such as navigation, settings, or context menus.
menu_floating_ui_description_suffix: library for positioning. It provides a flexible API for creating complex menu structures, including nested menus, checkable items, and disabled items.
menu_required_components_description: To create a menu, you will need to use the following components:
menu_component_menu_description: The root component that creates all the state and provides context to its children.
menu_component_menutrigger_description: Handles all the logic for the trigger element that opens the menu. It uses a render prop pattern to provide the necessary props and state to the trigger element.
menu_component_contextmenutrigger_descri: A variant of MenuTrigger that is designed to be used for context menus. It attaches the menu to a specified element and opens on right-click.
menu_component_menupopover_description: The container for the menu content. It handles the positioning and accessibility of the menu.
menu_component_menulist_description: A wrapper for the list of menu items.
menu_component_menuitem_description: Represents a single item in the menu. It can be a simple action or a trigger for a nested menu.
menu_component_button_or_splitbutton_des: The trigger element for the menu.
menu_optional_components_description: Other components that can be used within the menu include:
menu_component_menugroup_description: A wrapper for grouping related menu items together, with an optional header.
menu_component_menudivider_description: A visual separator between menu items or groups.
menu_component_menuitemcheckbox_descript: A menu item that can be checked or unchecked.
menu_component_menuitemswitch_descriptio: A menu item that can be toggled on or off.
menu_component_menuitemradio_description: A menu item that can be selected as part of a group of radio items.

menu_props_checkedvalues_description: Map-like object of checked values, keyed by group name.
menu_props_oncheckedvaluechange_descript: Callback fired when checked values change.
menu_props_hascheckmarks_description: States that menu items can contain selectable items and reserve slots for item alignment.
menu_props_hasicons_description: States that menu items can contain icons and reserve slots for item alignment.
menu_props_openingdelay_description: The delay in milliseconds before opening a submenu on hover. Default is 0.
menu_props_open_description: Controls the open state of the menu.
menu_props_onopenchange_description: Callback fired when the open state of the menu changes.
menu_props_openonhover_description: If true, the menu will open when the trigger is hovered.
menu_props_persistonitemactivation_descr: If true, the menu will not close when a menu item is activated.
menu_props_positionconfig_description: Configuration for the Floating UI positioning. It will be passed down to MenuPopover.
menu_props_shape_description: The shape of the trigger element. Default is 'rounded'.
menu_props_icon_description: An optional icon to display in the trigger element.
menu_props_disabled_description: If true, the trigger element will be disabled.
menu_props_menuitem_icon_description: An optional icon to display in the menu item.
menu_props_subtext_description: Optional subtext to display below the main content of the menu item.
menu_props_secondarycontent_description: Optional secondary content to display like a hint text.
menu_props_href_description: If provided, the menu item will render as an anchor element.
menu_props_menuitem_disabled_description: If true, the menu item will be disabled.
menu_props_onclick_description: Callback fired when the menu item is clicked.
menu_props_allmenuitemprops_description: All props from the MenuItem component are compatible.
menu_props_value_description: The value of the checkbox item. This is required for the item to be checkable.
menu_props_checked_description: Controls the checked state of the checkbox item. (Bindable)
menu_props_name_description: The name of the checkbox item, used for grouping related checkboxes.
menu_props_header_description: Optional header text to display above the group.
menu_checkable_nested_submenus_title: Menu with checkable items and nested submenus

nb_description: The NumberBox component allows users to input numeric values with specified constraints such as minimum, maximum, and step values.
nb_component_api_description_prefix: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
nb_variant_description: The variant prop determines the visual style of the NumberBox.
nb_props_value_description: The current value of the NumberBox.
nb_props_variant_description: The visual style of the NumberBox, e.g., 'inline', 'compact'.
nb_props_ref_description: The DOM reference to the input element.
nb_props_textboxprops_description: Additional props inherited from the TextBox component.
tv_description: The Tree View displays hierarchical data in a nested list where each item can be expanded, checked or selected. Items are composed with the TreeViewItem and TreeViewItemContent components — the tree does not accept a data prop.
tv_early_access_title: This component is available in early access.
tv_early_access_description: The API, features, and behavior of the component are subject to significant changes. We strongly advise against using this component in production environments at this time.
tv_usage_description: Nesting a TreeView inside a TreeViewItem of type='branch' creates a subtree. Use openItems / checkedItems on the root TreeView (bindable) to control open and checked state programmatically.
tv_props_ref_description: Bindable DOM reference of the root ul element.
tv_props_size_description: Visual size of the tree. Default is 'medium'.
tv_props_selectionmode_description: Selection mode for checkable items. Default is 'multiple'.
tv_props_openitems_description: Bindable list or set of open item ids. Uses SvelteSet when a virtualizer is provided.
tv_props_checkeditems_description: Bindable list or set of checked item ids. Uses SvelteSet when a virtualizer is provided.
tv_props_onopenchange_description: Callback fired when an item is expanded or collapsed.
tv_props_oncheckedchange_description: Callback fired when an item is checked or unchecked.
tv_props_virtualizer_description: Optional adapter for windowing or virtual list libraries. When provided, only the rendered slice is in the DOM.
tv_props_children_description: The TreeViewItem children of the tree.
tv_props_id_description: Unique identifier of the item. Required for open and checked state tracking.
tv_props_type_description: Whether the item is a leaf ('item') or a branch that can contain a nested TreeView.
tv_props_treeviewitem_ref_description: Bindable DOM reference of the li element.
tv_props_value_description: Optional value associated with the item.
tv_props_text_description: Optional accessible text label used by the tree.
tv_props_open_description: Bindable open state for type='branch' items.
tv_props_checked_description: Bindable checked state for selectable items.
tv_props_indeterminate_description: Whether the item is in an indeterminate check state.
tv_props_index_description: Explicit index — used with a virtualizer to keep keyboard navigation in sync.
tv_props_treeviewitem_onopenchange_descr: Callback fired when this item is expanded or collapsed.
tv_props_treeviewitem_oncheckedchange_de: Callback fired when this item is checked or unchecked.
tv_props_treeviewitemcontent_ref_descrip: Bindable DOM reference of the layout element.
tv_props_expandicon_description: Custom icon rendered for the expand or collapse affordance.
tv_props_iconbefore_description: Icon rendered before the item text.
tv_props_iconafter_description: Icon rendered after the item text.
tv_props_aside_description: Content rendered on the trailing side of the row.
tv_props_actions_description: Interactive actions rendered on hover or focus.
tooltip_description: A tooltip displays additional information about another component. The information is displayed above and near the target component.
tooltip_component_api_description_prefix: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
tooltip_content_description: The content prop specifies the content to be displayed in the tooltip when the user hovers over the target element. This can be a string, a Svelte component, or a Snippet.
tooltip_position_description: The positionConfig prop allows you to specify your own custom position using Floating UI's position configuration. This gives you more control over the placement of the tooltip, allowing you to define custom offsets, middleware, and more.
tooltip_with_arrow_description: The withArrow prop is a boolean that, when set to true, adds an arrow to the tooltip pointing towards the target element. This can help visually connect the tooltip to the element it is describing.
tooltip_delay_description: The openDelay and hideDelay props allow you to specify a delay, in milliseconds, before the tooltip is shown or hidden after the user hovers over the target element. This can help prevent the tooltip from appearing or disappearing too quickly.
tooltip_on_visible_change_description: The onVisibleChange prop is a callback function that is called whenever the visibility of the tooltip changes. This allows you to programmatically respond to the tooltip being shown or hidden.
tooltip_relationship_description: The relationship prop allows you to specify the relationship between the tooltip and the target element. This can be used for accessibility purposes, such as indicating that the tooltip is a description of the target element.
tooltip_props_content_description: The content to be displayed in the tooltip. This can be a string, a Svelte component, or a Snippet.
tooltip_props_positionconfig_description: The position configuration of the tooltip. This allows you to define custom offsets, middleware, and more.
tooltip_props_witharrow_description: Whether the tooltip should display an arrow pointing towards the target element.
tooltip_props_opendelay_description: The delay, in milliseconds, before the tooltip is shown after the user hovers over the target element.
tooltip_props_hidedelay_description: The delay, in milliseconds, before the tooltip is hidden after the user stops hovering over the target element.
tooltip_props_onvisiblechange_descriptio: A callback function that is called whenever the visibility of the tooltip changes.
tooltip_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the tooltip element.
tooltip_props_elementattributes_descript: All other attributes that can be applied to the tooltip element.
tswitch_description: A toggle switch represents a physical switch that allows someone to choose between two mutually exclusive options. For example, 'On/Off' and 'Show/Hide'. Choosing an option should produce an immediate result.
tswitch_props_ref_description: Get the DOM reference of the input element.
tswitch_props_label_description: The label for the toggle switch.
tswitch_props_labelattributes_descriptio: Attributes to be spread on the label wrapper element.
tswitch_props_labelelement_description: Get the DOM reference of the label element.
tswitch_props_disabled_description: Whether the toggle switch is disabled.
tswitch_props_checked_description: Whether the toggle switch is checked (on).
tswitch_props_elementattributes_descript: Additional attributes to apply to the toggle switch element.
ta_description: Textarea allows the user to enter and edit multiline text.
ta_component_api_description_before_link: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
ta_placeholder_description: The `placeholder` prop sets the placeholder text for the textarea, providing a hint to users about what to enter.
ta_resize_description: The `resize` prop controls whether the textarea can be resized by the user. It can be set to `none`, `both`, `horizontal`, or `vertical`. This allows you to control the resizing behavior of the textarea.
ta_on_change_description: The `onChange` event is triggered whenever the content of the textarea changes. This can be used to react to user input in real-time, such as validating input or updating other parts of the UI.
ta_props_placeholder_description: The placeholder text for the textarea.
ta_props_resize_description: Controls the resizing behavior of the textarea. Possible values: `'none'`, `'both'`, `'horizontal'`, `'vertical'`.
ta_props_onchange_description: Event handler for when the content of the textarea changes.
ta_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the textarea element.
ta_props_elementattributes_description: All other attributes that can be applied to the textarea element.
tb_description: The TextBox control lets a user type text into an app. It's typically used to capture a single line of text, but can be configured to capture multiple lines of text. The text displays on the screen in a simple, uniform, plaintext format.
tb_component_api_description_before_link: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
tb_type_description: The `type` prop specifies the type of input element. It can be set to various types such as `text`, `search`, `email`, `url`, `tel`, `password`, or `number`. This determines the behavior and validation of the input.
tb_input_element_description: The `ref` prop allows you to bind a reference to the underlying HTML input element (`bind:ref`). This can be useful for direct DOM manipulations or accessing native input properties. The wrapper element can be bound via `wrapperRef`.
tb_readonly_description: The `readonly` prop makes the input field read-only, preventing users from modifying its value. This is useful for displaying information that should not be edited.
tb_placeholder_description: The `placeholder` prop sets the placeholder text for the input field, providing a hint to users about what to enter.
tb_hide_buttons_description: The `hideActionButtons` prop allows you to hide the extra action buttons in the input, such as clear or submit buttons. This can be useful for a cleaner UI when those actions are not needed.
tb_query_submitted_description: The `querySubmitted` event is triggered when a query is submitted, such as when the user presses Enter in a search input. This allows you to handle the submission of the input value.
tb_text_changed_description: The `textChanged` event is triggered whenever the content of the text box changes. This can be used to react to user input in real-time, such as validating input or updating other parts of the UI.
tb_on_clear_description: The `onClear` event is triggered when the input is cleared, allowing you to handle any necessary actions when the user removes the input value.
tb_props_type_description: The type of the input element. Possible values: `'text'`, `'search'`, `'email'`, `'url'`, `'tel'`, `'password'`, `'number'`.
tb_props_ref_description: The DOM reference of the input element.
tb_props_wrapperref_description: The DOM reference of the wrapper element.
tb_props_wrapperattributes_description: Additional attributes forwarded to the wrapper element.
tb_props_placeholder_description: The placeholder text for the input.
tb_props_hideactionbuttons_description: Whether to hide the extra action buttons in the input.
tb_props_justify_description: Whether the input fills the full width of the container.
tb_props_contentbefore_description: Content rendered before the input (e.g. an icon).
tb_props_contentafter_description: Content rendered after the input (e.g. an icon).
tb_props_textchanged_description: Event triggered when content changes in the text box.
tb_props_querysubmitted_description: Event triggered when a query is submitted (Enter or search icon click on `type="search"`).
tb_props_onclear_description: Event triggered when the input is cleared.
tb_props_children_description: The children elements to render inside the input.
skeleton_description: The skeleton component provides a placeholder for content that is loading, giving users a visual indication of where content will appear once it has loaded.
skeleton_usage_description: The skeleton renders a placeholder element and sizes itself via standard HTML/CSS. Use the `style`, `class`, `width` and `height` attributes (or the `justify` prop) to control its dimensions.
skeleton_component_api_description_befor: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
skeleton_animation_description: The `animation` prop controls which type of animation is used for the skeleton. It can be set to `pulse` or `wave`. The default is `wave`.
skeleton_justify_description: Control if the skeleton should take the full width of its container or not. The default is `false`, meaning it will only take the `1:1` ratio of its width.
skeleton_shape_description: The `shape` prop allows you to change the shape of the skeleton. It can be set to `circle`, `square`, or `rounded`. The default is `rounded`.
skeleton_as_description: The `as` prop lets you choose the HTML tag used to render the skeleton. Possible values: `'div'` (default) or `'span'`.
skeleton_props_as_description: The HTML element used to render the skeleton. Default: `'div'`.
skeleton_props_animation_description: The animation type for the skeleton. Default: `'wave'`.
skeleton_props_shape_description: The shape of the skeleton. Default: `'rounded'`.
skeleton_props_justify_description: If `true` the skeleton fills the full width of its container; otherwise it keeps a `1:1` aspect ratio based on its width.
skeleton_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the skeleton element (`bind:element`).
skeleton_props_elementattributes_descrip: All other attributes are passed to the root element of the skeleton.
rating_description: The rating control allows users to view and set ratings that reflect degrees of satisfaction with content and services.
rating_component_api_description_before_: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props
rating_value_description: The `value` prop determines the current rating value. It accepts a number between 1 and 5, representing the rating level.
rating_interactive_description: The `interactive` prop allows the rating control to be interactive, enabling users to change the rating by clicking on the stars.
rating_max_description: The `max` prop sets the maximum rating value. By default, it is set to 5, but you can change it to any number.
rating_tooltips_description: The `Rating` component supports tooltips that display the current rating value when hovering over the stars. Requires the `interactive` prop to be set to true.
rating_props_interactive_description: If true, allows users to change the rating by clicking.
rating_props_size_description: The size of the rating stars (default is 'medium').
rating_props_tooltips_description: Array of tooltips for each rating level.
rating_props_ratecallback_description: Callback function that is called when the rating changes.
rb_description: Documentation for the Radio Button component.
rb_component_api_description: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props in the Component Props section below.
rb_grouping_description: While you can use name="inputName" to group items and have only one checked, you can use bind:group={someVariable} to update that variable with the value of the selected input and inspect it in your console.
rb_disabled_description: The disabled prop can be used to disable a radio button, preventing user interaction.
rb_checked_description: The checked prop allows you to control the checked state of the radio button. This is useful for controlled components.
rb_props_label_description: The label text for the radio button.
rb_props_group_description: Bindable value representing a group of radio inputs that the input will be bound to.
rb_props_checked_description: Indicates whether the radio button is checked.
rb_props_disabled_description: Indicates whether the radio button is disabled.
rb_props_ref_description: Gets the DOM reference of the radio button element.
rb_props_elementattributes_description: All standard HTML attributes for input elements can be applied.
pring_description: Documentation for the Progress Ring component.
pring_component_api_description: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props in the Component Props section below.
pring_value_description: The value prop determines the percentage of the progress ring that is filled. It should be a number between 0 and 100.
pring_indeterminate_description: The indeterminate prop allows the progress ring to display an indeterminate state, which is useful when the progress cannot be determined.
pring_hide_rail_description: The hideRail prop allows the progress ring to hide the rail, which is a background track for the progress indicator.
pring_status_description: The status prop allows you to set the status of the progress ring for visual feedback. It accepts values such as 'paused' or 'error'.
pring_props_value_description: The percentage of the progress ring that is filled.
pring_props_min_description: The minimum value of the progress ring. Default is 0.
pring_props_max_description: The maximum value of the progress ring. Default is 100.
pring_props_size_description: The size of the progress ring in pixels. Default is 32.
pring_props_indeterminate_description: If true, the progress ring displays an indeterminate state.
pring_props_hiderail_description: If true, the progress ring hides the rail.
pring_props_status_description: The status of the progress ring, for example 'paused' or 'error'.
pring_props_ref_description: The DOM reference to the SVG element.
pring_props_railelement_description: The DOM reference to the rail element.
pring_props_trackelement_description: The DOM reference to the track element.
pbar_description: Documentation for the Progress Bar component.
pbar_component_api_description: A brief explanation of the props that really need explaining. You can see the rest of the props in the Component Props section below.
pbar_value_description: The value prop sets the current progress value of the bar. It should be a number between 0 and 100.
pbar_indeterminate_description: If you do not set the value prop, the progress bar enters an indeterminate state, meaning it does not have a specific value. This is useful for operations where the duration is unknown.
pbar_hide_rail_description: The hideRail prop can be used to hide the progress bar rail.
pbar_status_description: The status prop allows you to set the status of the progress bar to 'paused' or 'error'. This changes the color of the progress bar to indicate different states.
pbar_props_value_description: The current progress value of the bar, between 0 and 100.
pbar_props_indeterminate_description: If true, the progress bar enters an indeterminate state.
pbar_props_hiderail_description: If true, the progress bar rail is hidden.
pbar_props_status_description: The current status of the progress bar.
pbar_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the progress bar element.
pbar_props_railelement_description: The DOM reference of the rail element.
pbar_props_trackelement_description: The DOM reference of the track element.
pbar_props_secondarytrackelement_descrip: The DOM reference of the secondary track element.
persona_text_align_description: A Persona supports three text alignments, with 'left' as the default position.
persona_text_position_description: A Persona supports four text positions: 'top', 'bottom', 'left', and 'right'. The default position is 'right'.
persona_size_description: A Persona supports custom sizes, with a default of 42px. You can set the size using the size prop. This applies to both the avatar or presence-only display and all text.
persona_avatar_description: A Persona wraps an avatar inside it, which can be customized with all the props available to the Avatar component.
persona_presence_description: A Persona can display presence information, such as online status or availability. This is controlled through the presence prop, which accepts an object with a status key.
persona_props_name_description: The full name of the person.
persona_props_primarytext_description: Main text, usually the person's role or title.
persona_props_secondarytext_description: Secondary text, for example location or status.
persona_props_tertiarytext_description: Tertiary text, for example team or department.
persona_props_size_description: Size in pixels for the avatar and text.
persona_props_textalign_description: Alignment of the text. Possible values are 'left', 'center', and 'right'.
persona_props_textposition_description: Position of the text relative to the avatar. Possible values are 'top', 'bottom', 'left', and 'right'.
persona_props_avataralign_description: Cross-axis alignment of the avatar relative to the text. Possible values are 'start', 'center', and 'end'.
persona_props_avatar_description: Avatar props object. See the Avatar component for details.
persona_props_presence_description: Presence object, for example { status: 'available' }. Status values are 'available', 'away', 'busy', 'do-not-disturb', 'offline', 'out-of-office', 'blocked', and 'unknown'.
persona_props_presenceonly_description: Shows only the presence indicator, with no avatar or text.
persona_props_element_description: The DOM reference of the persona root element.
